articleTitle: Automatic Generation of Programming Exercises
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Massive training of developers following the growing demands of the information technology industry requires teachers to automate their repetitive tasks. For training courses on programming, it is promising to use automatic generation and automatic grading of exercises that require a student to write a program. This article discusses the general scheme for constructing a programming exercises generator and identifies two classes of exercises, the generation of which can be automated: converting notation into code and converting data formats. Several examples of programming exercise generators are discussed. The experience of using exercise generators for the Python programming course is briefly described.

articleTitle: Corpus Linguistics Technology in Teaching Foreign Languages
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article deals with the use of the linguistic corpus in foreign language teaching. The authors define a linguistic corpus, concordance, and corpus linguistics. The importance of corpus analysis in extracting information from it, both from the point of view of a qualitative and quantitative perspective and in assessing the force of attraction of words, is especially emphasized.

articleTitle: Augmented and Virtual Reality Technologies in Education
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article examines the technologies of industrial revolution 4.0 - augmented reality and virtual reality. A detailed numerical analysis of known examples of the application of these technologies in the form of registered programs has been carried out. The possibilities of optimization of organizational and educational processes in higher technical education are analyzed. The methodology of using augmented reality in the organizational and educational process of a technical university is presented. A variant of augmented reality is proposed that allows you to “examine” a 3D model of an object by turning a paper marker. To implement it, the EV Toolbox augmented and virtual reality constructor is used.

articleTitle: Trends in the Development of Continuing Education: a Regional Aspect
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article discusses the trends in the development of continuing education. The study of the experience of residents of the Lipetsk region in the context of continuing education was conducted. Continuing education, in its various forms, is being updated as a mechanism for developing the region's human resources potential in the digital economy. The assessment of the degree of demand for various types of continuing education by specialists of the Lipetsk region was carried out.

articleTitle: Collaborative Learning Technologies for Project Work
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The paper presents an approach to learning based on the implementation of projects under the joint supervision and control of the educational organization and industrial partner. When students carry out projects, collaborative learning technologies are implemented. Periodic joint consultations of students by specialists of different profiles of educational organization and industrial partner help to bring the training closer to the real production process, and upon the completion of the project to get a ready-to-use product. Working in this mode allows students using modern technologies to work on the project, in particular, flexible methodologies of agile development. It helps not to formulate a completely ready technical task for the project, but to adjust it in the process of implementation. Tasks are formulated for a limited time interval of 1-2 weeks, after which the results are evaluated and tasks for the next stage are formed. The paper provides examples of works by students of Lipetsk State Technical University, performed in this format.

articleTitle: Development of Nonholonomic Wheeled Mobile Robot Model for Applying Time-efficient Control Strategy in Competitive Mobile robotics
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: This paper discusses the application of the developed mathematical model for controlling the motion of the nonholonomic mobile robot with the differential drive based on the ROBOTIS BIOLOID® STEM KIT for further use in competitive robotics, where young people of different ages can participate, both preschool, school, and college or university students. This model allows the application of optimized parameters of linear and angular velocities to servo drives of robots, which task is to navigate through the colored line (usually the color of white or black) in the minimal time interval using an array of infrared sensors. Additionally, it discusses the planning of movement on different tracks, straight lines, and various polygonal chains or curves, of which the competition track is usually created. Models of both two-wheeled and four-wheeled nonholonomic mobile robots with differential drives, which are used for experiments by students in our lab, are also discussed. Experimental data were obtained on the time intervals of mobile robots on different track sections; the results were compared before and after applying the optimization model.

articleTitle: Institutional Capacity of Informatization of Education
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article reflects the experience and gives fragments of the state of affairs for today and discusses the trends of future informatization, computerization and digitalization of education. The article analyses the activities of specialized organizations in the field of informatization of education on the example of the Academy of Informatization of Education; Criteria for the performance of these organizations have been identified; the algorithm of productive functioning of specialized organizations in the field of informatization of education has been determined.

articleTitle: The Practice of Implementing Distance Learning During the Pandemic: a Regional Aspect
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article analyzes the experience of rapid implementation of distance learning in the Lipetsk region during the pandemic. The article considers the practice of distance learning in secondary school, higher school and additional professional education. The role of all stakeholders of the educational process in the distance learning mode in the period of isolation is updated. A comparative analysis of the regional experience, in the context of the all-Russian experience, demonstrated the general difficulties and problems in the implementation of distance learning during the pandemic.

Author Keywords: advantages and disadvantages of distance learning

articleTitle: Introducing Dynamic Neighborhood Models into the Educational Process
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: This article describes the application of dynamic neighborhood models in the educational process of higher education institutions. The disciplines and corresponding areas of training at Lipetsk State Technical University, in which dynamic neighborhood models are implemented, are presented. The example of carrying out the laboratory work on performing identification of linear and quadratic dynamic neighborhood models by using information technologies, namely the use of MS Excel, Mathcad, and Scilab. The steps of laboratory work in each of the programs are described in detail. The results of this work are shown. Conclusions are made.

articleTitle: Selection of Learning Path of Specialist Team for Actions in Emergency Situations
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The specific features of specialist training for emergency actions have been analyzed. The concept of emergency is understood as situations resulted form an accident or dangerous natural phenomenon, catastrophe or other disaster. The necessity of learning path selection optimization has been justified. Learning path is a set and sequence of learning actions to acquire necessary competences. Learning process model and algorithm that allows to generate automatically an optimal path for training a group of specialists, taking into account their initial level of learning and the purpose of learning have been developed. An example of the model and its software implementation, which allows solving this problem, is given.

articleTitle: Opportunities of Digital Education for Sustainable Development of Society
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article emphasizes the importance of digital education for further development in connection with the active use by society of the opportunities that technologies open up in general. The strengths and weaknesses of the transition to digital education and the formation of exclusively network, digital and global institutions in the future are summarized, the threats that hinder the mass transition to blended forms of education are considered.

articleTitle: Implementation of the «Cloud Technologies in Education» Supplementary Vocational Education Program
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The need of the state in personnel ready to use digital technologies in their activities has been established. The activities aimed at developing digital competences of people have been considered. The structure, content, and instructional implications of implementation of the “Cloud Technologies in Education” supplementary vocational education program have been presented.

articleTitle: Digital Literacy in the Aspect of Continuing Teacher's Education
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article discusses the issue of digital literacy in the aspect of continuing education. Theoretical analysis of the problem is given. Diagnostics were carried out to determine the main problems of insufficient digital literacy of teachers. Recommendations have been developed to improve digital literacy in the teacher's continuing education system.

articleTitle: Analysis and Forecasting of the Market of Educational Services of the Region
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article focuses on analysis of educational indicators related to the areas of employment in demand in the regional labor market of Voronezh Oblast. Based on the collected data from the Internet and processed data, the ratio of university graduates and vacancies is analyzed; balanced and unbalanced areas of employment are determined. A general approach to building an information system for collecting and processing data for the analysis and forecasting of areas in demand in the regional educational market is proposed.

articleTitle: Trends and Prospects of the Educational Technologies Development
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Authors of the present paper have examined the main existing learning formats and educational technologies regarding the prospects of their development. The existing formats have been analyzed together with the more promising ones, pointing out strengths and limitations of both. Research methodology includes data collection, analysis, and systematization from the open sources, combined with the author's personal experience in using various teaching formats in university. As the result of the present research, the most promising combinations of educational formats have been identified and described regarding pros and cons of each of them, as well as software suitable for organizing distanced and hybrid formats. The research has shown that hybrid format turned out to be the most effective one.

articleTitle: Information and Communication Technologies in the Training of Students Majoring in Applied Mathematics and Computer Science
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The purpose of the work is to study various aspects of using information and communication technologies to prepare students studying in the direction of training “Applied Mathematics and Informatics.” The educational objectives, principles, and advantages of using ICT in higher education are highlighted. Based on the analysis of educational standards in this area, the goals, objectives, principles, functions of ICT in teaching stochastics are determined. The conclusion is made about a consistent, expedient combination of traditional educational technologies and ICT in the educational process. It is noted that a modern classical university's information and educational environment creates conditions for the training of specialists who meet these requirements.

articleTitle: Enhancement of Multimedia Programs to Improve the Quality and Efficiency of Distance Education
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: This article is based on giving basic information about developing multimedia programs with the purpose of suggesting strategies for challenging high standard in distance learning programs at higher education level. At present, distance education is becoming an important part of education system in globalization. Every institution is focusing on challenging and offering their educational course through general as well through distance education devices in order to make market for its programs. There is a major goal and need to introduce quality distance education programs.

articleTitle: Obstacles and Limitations in the Use of Modern Technologies in Higher Education During the Covid-19 Pandemic in Slovakia
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Three days after the first case of COVID-19 in Slovakia, face-to-face education was interrupted at all types of schools. Teachers suddenly had to deal with the question of how they would continue in the teaching process. The article deals with the problems that Slovak university teachers had to solve during the COVID-19 pandemic in the introduction of modern technologies into the teaching process. We are interested in the question of how the teaching process continued in the online space. In Slovakia, there have been several problems with the introduction of online teaching. In the article, we explain that in Slovakia we observe two waves of pandemics and two approaches to teaching. While during the first wave there was no uniform approach to teaching, during the second wave teachers used several online platforms. We identify several problems that have emerged even after the start of using modern technology.

articleTitle: Transformation of the Institute of Education in the Context of Digitalization
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Modern information technologies, interactive forms of communication and communication have been actively introduced into the field of education over the past few years, making it possible to transfer the process of reproduction of knowledge to a new level of quality. The transition from computerization to informatization leads to the creation of a developed information and educational environment, which has a number of advantages in the development of new knowledge and certain contradictions. One of the consequences of the depth processes of digitalization of education is the strengthening of social stratification and social inequality. On the one hand, information technologies provide access to knowledge, and on the other, they contribute to the preampiness and degradation of society. Unequal access to knowledge with apparent accessibility exacerbates the elitization of education. An exception (or restriction of interaction) from the educational process of the teacher's personality leads to the loss of social skills, the ability to interact, critical thinking, a decrease in creative potential through the development of template thinking.

articleTitle: Developing a Dynamic Number Card Game to Support Students' Number Sense: A Preliminary Study
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The android-based learning media becomes more popular nowadays. Many students have positive attitudes toward activities involving games including in mathematics learning. In order to support first grade students' learning number sense, we develop a dynamic number card game. The method used in this study is research and development using the ADDIE model. The process begins with the analysis of the problem related to mathematics learning in elementary school, design the dynamic number card game using android studio, develop it after getting a review from two experts, material and media experts, then test it two three first-grade students, and conduct a general evaluation from this process. The results of this study indicate that the dynamic number card game has been passed the review process from the experts, and the students also have positive attitude towards their experience using of the dynamic number card game.

articleTitle: IoT in Effective Distance Learning Process
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: IOT in distance learning and self education allow to increase the efficiency of studying up to 20% more. During the video lesson the IOT devices are monitoring the level of the brain activity and sending the feedback to the software program. Digital image and video stream are modulated with the signals which switch the brain into the active state. At the periods of tiredness or/and the important moments of the lecture course these signals are keeping the brain in active state and allow to increase the efficiency of memorisation and boost up the overall learning process.

articleTitle: Screen Time and Health of Children and Adolescents
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: In the period of self-isolation during the COVID-19 pandemic the time of contact of children and adolescents with technical means of Internet access has significantly increased, and accordingly time of contact of the students with device screens also increased. In turn, this significantly affected the health of students. Not all countries of the world have hygienic regulations in this area. Nevertheless, almost all countries of the world are trying to find ways to optimize the length of screen time for children and adolescents and are preparing recommendations to prevent negative health consequences. For the purposes of this study, we have reviewed the literature of recent years, reflecting the results of both individual and national studies focused primarily on identifying the causes of deterioration of the health of children and adolescents under the influence of digital technologies. The most significant changes, that can be caused by increase in screen time are disorders of mental health and sleep. Further consequences are disorders in the musculoskeletal system coupled with pain syndrome, metabolic disorders and obesity, hypodynamia. The indirect consequences are behavioural disorders and, in a broader sense, problems in the socialization of the child. It is currently not possible to exclude the use of various technical means. Moreover, they are used not only for entertainment, but also for educational purposes, and during the COVID-19 pandemic, they have often become the only means of any external communication and activities. In these conditions, it is necessary not only to know about the causes and consequences of the negative impact of technical means and various indicators, including screen time, but also to have an idea of approaches and ways to prevent their negative impact.

Author Keywords: Recommendations for A Healthy Lifestyle negative impact

articleTitle: Digital Technologies in Preschool Education: Risks and Prospect
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The paper aims to analyze one of the new problems of preschool education: the problem of digital education. On the one hand, digitalization has embraced all levels of the Russian education system and represents a powerful trend that radically changes the educational process, and on the other hand, there are certain risks, fears of teachers and parents about the negative impact of digital education technologies on the formation and development of a child's personality. Research in this area is still very discreet, nevertheless, it allows us to see the outlines of the educational process, organized with regard to the use of digital technologies.

articleTitle: Open Moodle Tools for a Psychological Assessment
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Psychological support is an important part of learning processes. Its main sub-process is a psychological assessment. We develop tools to provide the assessment with the use of Moodle. A new method of a psychological tests implementation based on the Quiz module is presented. As an example of its applicability, we propose a new system of plugins to implement Lusher color test and Amthauer test. We conducted experiments with the participation of about 200 students and collected both learning performance and psychological datasets. A preliminary analysis of theirs connections is given.

articleTitle: Understanding P-value through Experiments
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Statistical experiments radically change teaching methods and allow us to teach statistics at a deeper and more meaningful level. In this article, we discuss the possibilities offered by statistical experiments in math packages to study the notion of p-value (or p-level) and other statistical tools. In particular, an experimental verification of the central limit theorem is described and various criteria for testing hypotheses about the type of distribution are compared. Experimental material is used to explain the advantage of applying p-value in the case of correlation coefficient and the geometric meaning of the multiple correlation coefficient is explained. The problem of choosing a regression model depending not only on the correlation coefficient but also on tolerances of predictors is discussed.

articleTitle: Application of Routine Calculations for Organization of Independent Work of Students in Applied Areas of Training Using Digital and Information Technologies
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The paper deals with the methodology for organizing independent work in mathematics using routine calculations. The importance of their use for students of applied areas of training, in particular, students of medical universities, is substantiated. The main points of course development in the Moodle system are highlighted, which allow to simplify the lecturer's work.

articleTitle: Educational Technologies for Advanced Training in FPGA Design
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article considers the issues of building advanced training courses for specialists using FPGAs to build digital devices and systems on a chip. The types of projects that require training materials of different levels of complexity are considered and approaches to the construction of training courses for such projects are proposed. Attention is drawn to the “problems of the real world” associated with the difference between real signals coming from external devices from their idealized representation used in simulators. This factor complicates the application of distance learning technologies based on the use of only software tools and requires the use of remote access to real equipment, which implies the organization of the educational process based on laboratory stands with FPGA and connection of real signal sources.

articleTitle: Relevant Legal Aspects of Sustainable Technologies of the Digital Economy in the Educational Organization
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article discusses topical issues of the practical implementation of sustainable technologies of the digital economy in the educational process of an educational organization.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Features of the Introduction of Distance Learning During the Coronavirus Pandemic
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article devoted to distance education. The mail task of the article is to justify and explain different aspekt of distance learning. The article shows forms of learning, the major directions of development of distance learning, the differences between distance learning and the traditional one. The problems that students and teachers face in distance learning are distinguished. Distance education is proved to be regarded as an independent form of training, because it has significant distinctions, which can not be realised in the traditional manner.

articleTitle: Stabilization of Neighborhood Systems with the Introduction of Dynamic Coefficients of Neighborhood Fuzziness
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The study of the theory of neighborhood systems is promising in the training of students of technical specialties, since they allow you to model and control complex distributed objects and processes that are found in industry, while being simple and accurate. For modeling distributed processes, it is advisable to use fuzzy-neighborhood systems, and in particular systems with dynamic coefficients of neighborhood fuzziness. In this work, the problem of stabilizing the nominal mode due to control parameters and due to dynamic coefficients of neighborhood fuzziness for initial linear and bilinear neighborhood models is considered.

articleTitle: Aspects of Using Intelligent Cloud Technologies in Professional Training of General Practitioners
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Currently, there is a clear trend towards personalized medicine that will be most effective when using cloud technologies. With new digital services, there is also a growing need for cloud-based transformation of essential medical systems and applications to improve the quality of health worker education. The challenge for the near future is the development of cloud solutions into an intelligent physician assistant, including the introduction of integrated clinical applications, automatic quality control of medical care and other areas that can significantly improve the quality of medical care and increase the effectiveness of training. The article discusses the possibility of using cloud applications used by various organizations for professional retraining of general practitioners. A generalized methodology for the use of universal interfaces for clinical applications by general practitioners in the process of their professional retraining is presented. Aspects of standardization of medical information systems and the use of standard products, including ontologies in the creation of cloud learning environments, are noted. It also highlights the need for healthcare leaders to explore integrated solutions that include medical imaging, health care management and financial management. The article presents the possibility of using Predix cloud platform solutions for training general practitioners.

articleTitle: Student Research Project: Development of an Interactive Terminal for the Selection and Sale of Car Electronics
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: This article is considered the research project of future master of innovatics on design, creation and introduction of electronic terminals for the choice of goods in shops of electronics. The concrete example of development of the interactive terminal on automobile acoustics of Pioneer realized in M. Video supermarket is described.

articleTitle: Competency Formation of a University Graduate: Model for Assessment
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The authors of the article propose a model describing the characteristics of a university graduate. The discussed model comprises a set of competencies formed in the learning process. A tiered approach to assessing the parameters of the model is considered. The authors analyse the criteria for identifying model tiers. Logical links between the parameters and levels of the model are determined.

articleTitle: Media Literacy and Media Education
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Features of perception of media texts are considered, modern theories of media education are analyzed, which accumulate pedagogical theories and theories of media in themselves. Directions of development of media education are formulated, components of formation of media literacy and media competency are distinguished.

articleTitle: Requirements for Electronic Educational Resources for Blended Learning in Topological Optimization Discipline
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: In a pandemic, many universities have switched to blended learning. This implies an increase in the volume of students' independent work and may lead to a decrease in the quality of education. In this regard, the article substantiates expedient content, as well as functional requirements for electronic educational resources for the realization of a blended learning model. The authors using the example of development of electronic educational resources for studying the discipline “Topological optimization” implement the stated requirements. The research novelty is determined by the fact that teachers can change the content of resources that has an interactive graphical interface that meets the requirements of safety and comfort, using simple computer programs Notepad, Paint and Word. The practical significance of the study is determined by the reduction of information inequality among students with the help of these resources in conditions of insufficient hardware and software of students.

articleTitle: Legal Aspects and Issues of E-Learning in the Arab Region
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The development process and problems of e-learning in the Arab region are considered. The most acute question is about the impact on the consciousness of students through the use of various corporate platforms and messengers. Today, legal regulation and responsibility for this type of act remains the cornerstone for fuqaha and representatives of local governments.

articleTitle: Digital Resources for Verifying Plagiat Documents at a Higher Education Institution: Standardization Issues and Specifications
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article considers topical issues of using specialized digital resources in order to detect “incorrect borrowings” in scientific publications, graduate qualification works, dissertations and problems associated with their use. As a solution, a methodology for systematization and certification based on harmonization of systems and the development of common criteria is proposed. And also questions are revealed as tutorial issues in the borrowing detection support system and the need to develop united unified standards containing an algorithm for working with a certain borrowing detection system, methodological, technological, regulatory aspects of checking work for “incorrect borrowing” (plagiarism).

articleTitle: Interactive Training Model of the Thermal Mode for a Hot Rolling Mill
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: A training program for modeling the thermal mode of hot rolling mill 2000 was developed. It allows to calculate the temperature of the strip and working rolls for a given rolling regime. It is possible to interactively vary the rolling parameters to analyze and adjust the technology. The model was tested and adapted to the actual data for several steel grades. Results of numerical experiments on strip temperature comparison under different cooling conditions are presented. The program is useful for students of mathematics and metallurgy, as well as for advanced training of mill personnel and process engineers.

articleTitle: The Use of Distant Technologies for International Summer School - 2020 and Winter School - 2021
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Summer and Winter international schools for medical students during COVID-19 pandemic represent contemporary approach to distant education. The article represents the results of research of various motivational, cognitive and informational aspects of distant teaching international medical students in Summer and Winter schools.

articleTitle: Miniature Power Divider on Artificial Transmission Lines in Modern Maritime Communications
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: From a General point of view, let's consider a miniature power divider. The use of artificial transmission lines for marine applications allows you to reduce the overall dimensions and obtain a layout with reproducible dimensions. Models of a conventional and compact coupler with a Central frequency of 0.9 GHz were obtained. The area of the compact is 77.5% less than the area of a conventional power divider. The resulting device can be used in various systems where small dimensions are required.

articleTitle: Training in Protective Driving of a Car at a Large Industrial Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Protective driving is driving a car in which the driver, regardless of the actions of other drivers and the situation on the road, does not allow road accidents. Experienced and professional drivers are still at risk of getting into accidents due to factors beyond their control. This is because the actions of other road users have an impact on the overall situation, leading to numerous, dangerous situations. The growth of motorization and the increase in the number of its victims caused the need to improve the professional skills of drivers, especially in large industrial enterprises. The level of risk of an emergency is reduced when using the rules of protective driving developed by drivers as a result of training. Training in protective driving at a large industrial enterprise will improve the professional skills of drivers and improve road safety.

articleTitle: Developing Research Skills During Active Learning Hybrid Building Constructions
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Hybrid building constructions are used for exemplifying the active learning approach in developing the following research skills of the prospective scientist: identifying and tackling the scientific problem, investigating complex building constructions numerically and experimentally, estimating structural parameters, identifying the worst external impacts and improving the construction. The bending-active structure is used to illustrate that a conventional approach for dealing with a scientific problem may fail and nonstandard decisions should be provided. Numerical investigation is considered for identifying the worst impacts on the ribbed dome construction and for estimating structural parameters of the cable roof. Graphical approach is used. In terms of development of the professional skills, it is far superior to precise but convoluted analytical techniques. Topological optimization is exemplified with the ribbed dome. Having tried and analyzed a number of embodiments the researcher develops the skills in targeted improving of the construction. Laboratory investigation of the cable roof and the bending-active structure are considered. Combining the lab activity and digital technologies gives better outcomes for developing professional competences of the prospective researcher.

articleTitle: State Strategy for Adult Education
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: In all developed countries, the creation of high-quality jobs, the acquisition of professional skills by employees, and the improvement of their skills are considered as a key link in solving the problem of ensuring sustainable economic growth [1, p. 4]. In Russia, this problem is superimposed on the aging of the population [2], which causes the acceleration of the reduction of its labor force and increases the value of the contribution of each employee [3, p. 2]. The analysis of the current state of adult education and the barriers to adult education in Russia is becoming increasingly relevant. The experience of developed countries, as well as the experience of Eastern Europe, can be used to develop a state strategy for adult education in rapidly changing technological conditions (Industry 4.0) and critical conditions of society (the spread of the Covid-19 virus infection).

articleTitle: Innovative Intelligent Technologies and Information Security in the Training of Doctors
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article discusses the features of the development and use of intelligent learning environments for healthcare professionals. It is emphasized that in the context of digitalization of healthcare, for the successful management of information resources of training processes for medical specialists, it is necessary to create and use training systems that cover a set of operational medical solutions. It is noted that ontologies serve as a means of structuring and exchanging data, combining already existing stocks of knowledge, searching and editing existing knowledge. It has been proven that the complexity of modern hardware and software of medical systems leads to a high probability of errors and vulnerabilities and requires good technological compatibility and the use of intelligent support tools. And also the creation of protective equipment that support the full cycle of training, including diagnostic processes. As a result of the use of intellectual support tools at a new level of integration, many issues related to determining the required level of security of information resources when making medical decisions are being comprehensively resolved.

articleTitle: Application of Information and Communication Technologies in the Network Interaction of Educational Institutions, Enterprises and Organizations
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article considers the features of the use of information and communication technologies in the network interaction of educational institutions, enterprises and organizations on the example of the interaction of a university and a large enterprise.

articleTitle: Social Network Valuation Using the Discounting Cash Flow Method
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Social networks are different from traditional companies, therefore, the article discusses the methodology of social networks valuation is considered, as well as the features arising by the specifics of the activities of such companies. The results are interpreted and the conclusions are made regarding the accuracy of social network valuation by discounting cash flows of the company.

articleTitle: Innovations in Teaching Network-Based Planning
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: In the present paper, authors propose some methodical and methodological innovations in education aimed at formation of students' competencies in the field of the network-based planning and management. Examples related to teaching the PERT method are given.

articleTitle: On the Development of the Concept of Innovative Training of Future Teachers of Informatics in the Conditions of Digital Transformation of Society
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The data of studies on the readiness of teachers for digital transformation are presented, a conclusion is made about the contradiction between the demands of the modern digital society for the quality of professional training of future teachers of informatics and the lack of approved innovative approaches for the implementation of the tasks. A mechanism for solving the problem is proposed - the development of a concept for innovative training of future teachers of informatics. For its implementation, the Innovation Center for the Training of Teachers of Informatics of the Tula Region was created.

articleTitle: The Role of Digitalization in the Process of Teaching a Foreign Language and in the Formation of a Foreign Language Competence of Future Specialists
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Globalization and the development of digital technologies affect not only the political, economic development of the country, but also higher education. The modernization of the higher education field led to the digitalization of educational disciplines. The importance of foreign language proficiency is highly stressed in conditions of modern society development. The ability to communicate in a foreign language is one of the most important indicators of today specialist's competitiveness. Digitalization plays a significant role in teaching and provides a greater opportunity to improve foreign language skills. A competent organization of a foreign language teaching process with the use of digital technologies will contribute to increasing students' motivation and cognitive activity, the development of their creative abilities and skills to use a foreign language. Modern digital technologies used in a foreign language teaching also individualize the learning process, create conditions for self-education and self-development, and form the foreign-language competence of future specialists.

Author Keywords: conditions for the digital technologies use

articleTitle: Monitoring Safety of Learner Access in Information Learning System
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article discusses the process of implementing sensitivity analysis in the process of modeling dynamic systems. A method of fuzzy sensitivity analysis in information learning systems is proposed, which provides a more systematic approach than in traditional analysis. A system for monitoring access of learner of information relations in the learning process to protected information objects is described. The main element of the analysis based on the theory of fuzzy sets are membership functions, which simulate the degree of preference of the system of parameters: the transfer function and the output parameter of the intelligent information learning system as a membership function, respectively.

articleTitle: The State of Health and Dynamics of the Attitude of Students to Its Strengthening by Means of Physical Culture
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The health of students is of great social and state importance. The article presents the results of many years of research on the dynamics of students attitudes to certain aspects that make up health; optimal motor activity, the consequences of violations of the principles of nutrition and its impact on self-esteem. The formation of value orientations, norms, attitudes, patterns of behavior develops more intensively during the student period. The state of health of students, together with the quality of professionalism, is one of the indicators of evaluating the activities of the university training of highly qualified specialists. This affects the economic and social well-being of the country. The analysis of scientific literature and research devoted to this problem is becoming more and more relevant. The article presents the results of many years of research on the dynamics of students attitudes to certain aspects that make up health; optimal motor activity, the consequences of violations of the principles of nutrition and its impact on self-esteem.

articleTitle: Automation of Procedures of Classification of Service Staff for Complex Multifunctional Processes
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Such method of training as training on the workplace, continuing education, whether it is training, retraining or advanced training, does not lose its relevance nowadays. However, the issue of rationalized and optimal allocation of the budget for training and development of employees, the choice of approaches to budget formation causes multiple disputes and discussions. The article deals with the automation of procedures for classifying service staff of complex multifunctional processes. These procedures are necessary for optimizing organizational tasks during the maintenance of high-tech equipment. The possibility of optimizing service processes based on the parameters set by the requirements for performing a certain type of work and the qualifications of service groups is considered.

articleTitle: On Some Results of the Work of the Information System for Monitoring Research Activities of a University
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The results of using the information system for monitoring research work at the Oryol State University named after I.S. Turgenev are considered. An analysis of the data obtained over 6 years of operation of the system was carried out, regularities were revealed and recommendations were given on the use of the system.

articleTitle: Proportional Optimization of Traditional and Online Forms of Technical Specialties Studying in Higher Educational
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article describes the experience of using the electronic educational portal for distance traditional education. The scope of application of LMS (LMS - learning management system) for training and retraining of specialists of engineering specialties is presented, advantages and advantages of distance learning are highlighted. The authors discuss the most effective combination of traditional and remote forms of training, give the results of an educational experiment on the use of intermediate tests for in-depth mastering of content. The labour intensity of distance learning in comparison with face-to-face training is assessed. The conclusion is made about the most optimal correspondence of forms of training for technical specialties at the current stage. A pedagogical experiment conducted in two groups of students approximately equal in intellectual opportunities is described.

articleTitle: The Technology of Collaboration Between Science and General Education in Case of the Activities of a Public Organization
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The technology of collaboration between science and general education offers the solution to the problem of isolation of scientific pedagogical knowledge from the practice of general education. Having united in a public organization scientists-educators interact actively with teachers and schoolchildren. The technology is implemented through the following areas: massive open contests for schoolchildren; scientific and practical conferences for teachers; methodical resource bank for teachers; advanced training of teachers; groups of teachers on social media. The platform for the technology is the portal of a public organization

Author Keywords: integration of science and general education
scientific and practical conferences for teachers
groups of teachers on social media

articleTitle: Optimization of the Subsystem for the Movement of Electronic Documents in Educational Organization
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Electronic document management systems are currently common in different organizations. If such systems are implemented in educational organizations with requirements of a large scale, as well as a complex organization, then in some cases a significant amount of resources is required. The implementation of their development, development for universal design solutions based on information technology can be carried out on the basis of methods of system analysis and mathematical modeling. This paper has developed a mathematical model of information processing in electronic document management systems in educational institutions. Such a model is used in order to formalize the structure of documents, to optimize the processes of processing, interaction and movement of documents.

articleTitle: Software Supports for Remote Examination on Mathematical Disciplines in Higher Education
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article discusses one of the ways to carry tests for students in mathematical disciplines in the context of distance learning. This approach involves the use of free software for issuing and receiving control tasks and organizing video conferencing. The features of control over the execution of tasks which are fair and equal for all students calculation of the time in the achieved by using password-protected archives created by means of macros. The results of the statistical analysis of the results of remote and face-to-face control activities are presented.

articleTitle: Online Learning of Computer Science to Schoolchildren Using Interactive Educational Posters
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: This article deals with questions of organization online schoolchildren training using interactive posters as multidimensional didactic tools for a computer science teacher. The concept of “interactive posters” discusses and shows their important role for activating and managing the activities of schoolchildren in full-time and remote forms of interaction. We are considering the design and development of interactive posters on the web platform with the specifics of training in informatics and overcoming the problems of modern schoolchildren related to clip thinking.

articleTitle: Digital Technologies for Continuing Education Using Foreign Language Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Digital tools for support of continuous learning using the example of learning foreign languages are considered. The focus is on self-learning applications. The main standard components specific to language applications are highlighted. You define the different elements and methods that are specific to different types of applications. A summary of integrated digital platforms for distance learning is provided.

articleTitle: Dynamics in the Spheres of Student's Individuality During the Pandemic COVID-19
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The research focuses on the characteristics of the dynamics in the spheres of student's individuality during the pandemic COVID-19. Fifty-nine future Primary school teachers of the first-year studying have taken part in this research. The first group consists of students, who study in the conditions of real interaction with lecturers and other students before the pandemic of 2019. The second group takes part in the research in 2020: students have finished Secondary school in distance format of studying. This group has been taking part in the mixed education (combining virtual and face-to-face education) for one term at the university. The respondents were asked to complete "Questionnaire of student's individuality" for measuring their individuality spheres: intellectual, motivational, emotional, volitional, practical and subject-oriented, existential and self-regulative one. The participants were analyzing the components of all seven spheres of the individuality at the beginning of the first term (in September) and at the end of it (in late December) during their university studying. The research results show the mixed format of traditional and distance learning in the pandemic has influenced on the dynamics of all spheres of students' individuality. The dynamics in the existential sphere at the university is defined by the awareness of internal world, in the volitional sphere - the skill to overcome external and internal difficulties, in the self-regulative sphere - physical self-monitoring skills and cognitive analysis. In the process of mixed education the emotional, motivational, intellectual, practical and subject-oriented spheres are actively transformed. The dynamics of some components of these spheres demonstrates the indeterminacy. Changes in the emotional sphere are identifies with the skills to overcome the anxiety, but only this component doesn't demonstrate positive dynamics. In the motivational sphere forced isolation reduces a demand for a cooperation, the possibility of free access to many informative resources reduces a need in the knowledge of different disciplines. The demand for the self-development determines the main dynamics of this sphere. In the intellectual sphere individual characteristics of the cognitive activity are fundamental, but long-term interaction with the informative channel influences on the stability of the awareness. The value of the creative skills in the practical and subject-oriented spheres is increasing, but the distance learning impacts negatively on student's workability.

articleTitle: «The Safety Concept» and a New Approach to Worker Safety Training
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Introducing a different understanding of today's world and of the systems we work in and depend upon may require something akin to a paradigm shift. The safety community has developed a consensus on how things work and how safety can be ensured, but the increase of knowledge has levelled off, and the wicked problem of adverse events has continued. We must face the fact that the world cannot be explained by cause-effect models. Incidents and accidents do not only happen in a linear manner, but include emergent phenomena stemming from the complexity of the overall health system. Asking for "why and because" does not suffice to explain the system in use and does not lead to animprovement in safety.

articleTitle: On the Prospects of Increasing Publication Activity in the ‘Informatization of Education’ Field
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: In this communication, I briefly analyze the consequences of the Russian government's unrealistic policy concerning researchers' publication output. Provided a variety of publication opportunities, including repositories of research data and preprints, articles in scientific journals and conference proceedings remain to be the main option. Significant risks are involved when aiming to fulfil the government's requirements at all costs, including the use of unethical services. Thus, brokers forward their customers' articles to non-peer-reviewed journals, which are regularly discontinued in citation databases. It is noted that conference proceedings remain to be the main source of scientific information in computer sciences. In this study, a thematic search across the ‘informatization of education’ field in Scopus was conducted to compare the publication dynamics of Russian and Chinese authors. A significant difference was observed between the countries both in terms of the thematic scope of conducted research and publication sources. It is concluded that Russian science managers should study the experience of foreign countries. For example, China underwent a period of excessive reliance on the quantitative instruments in measuring research performance, which resulted in ethical violations and multiple retractions. Recommendations are given for improving the ranking and recognition of Russian researchers among the international scientific community.

articleTitle: Digital Transformation of the Management of the Polyprofessional Trajectory of the Constituent Entity of Education
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article discloses the problem of digital transformation of the management of the polyprofessional trajectory of the subject of education and the algorithm for its solution. The creation of an integrated information and communication environment of the region on the basis of a digital university is considered as the optimal way of digital transformation of managing the polyprofessional trajectory of the subject of education. In this regard, the basic approaches and methods, regulatory and technological foundations of the operation of the integrated information and communication environment of the region on the basis of a digital university are revealed.

Author Keywords: integrated information and communication environment of the region

articleTitle: Distance Learning Technologies and Digital Learning in the Legal Field of the Educational Environment. Problems and Prospects
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Object: The purpose of this article is to analyze the social and legal risks in the implementation of distance education technologies and the prospects for the development of digital learning at all levels of the education system during the period of cybersocialization of society caused by the COVID-19 pandemic. Methods: The article uses the following research methods: theoretical and practical analysis, generalization, abstraction, formal-legal and comparative-legal. Findings: The results of the study are: 1. The author's definition of minimizing the existing legal and technical gaps in the use of an electronic information educational system. 2. The learning trajectory is to strive for personalization. 3. Social and legal blurring of the boundaries of time and space in the implementation of educational programmes. Conclusions: 1. In the course of the introduction of distance technologies in education, the demand for the ability to analyze systems and methods of process management is growing, and traditional educational results are being redefined during the digital transformation of the education system. 2. The concepts of subject and person in the light of the implementation of goals in a situation of uncertainty caused by the consequences of the pandemic interact in accordance with the programme of information creation and processing. 3. When switching to a remote format of work, it is necessary to pay special attention to the process of individualization of digital learning. 4. It seems that the theory of contextual education can serve as the basic theory. 5. In the curricula of secondary schools and institutions of secondary vocational education, as well as higher education, it is necessary to introduce a scientifically-based practical course on training in the competent use of digital devices. 6. It is necessary to have a unified information and educational space in universities, a portal of secondary education, and an online rating system. Create a mobile application where you can see the class schedule.

articleTitle: Learning Activities for Mastering Flexible Roof Constructions
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Flexible roofs become an integral part of modern building constructions. Being widely used for public buildings, they have great potential in the field of industrial construction as well. Flexible roofs, however, possess complex structural behavior. They require deep understanding of the key concepts by designers and project managers, who implement them into a real life. Civil engineering and architectural specializations need to incorporate flexible constructions into the academic activity. It will ensure competitiveness of prospective specialists in the job market. Active learning approach is considered for mastering flexible roof structures. Prototyping is an essential tool for long-term memorization of the key concepts. Modern computer technologies and specialized software packages, however, gradually displace laboratory modeling. Structural deformability, geometrically nonlinear behavior, preliminary stressing and equilibrium structural shape can be easily grasped by means of computer simulation and numerical investigation of exemplary constructions.

articleTitle: Integration of Science and Education: Digitalization as the Basis for Integrated Interdisciplinary Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article summarizes the experience of integrating science and education in management and economics at the Russian State University for the Humanities on the basis of research conducted at the Institute of Control Sciences of the Russian Academy of Sciences. The main methodological principles and methods of trans - and interdisciplinary training of bachelors and undergraduates using digital and remote technologies are considered. The goals, tasks, and objects of study are formulated. The methodological principles of teaching based on the object-functional approach in the theory of management are proposed. The experience of teaching, including interactive teaching methods, is considered.

Author Keywords: Russian State University for the Humanities
Institute of Control Sciences of the Russian Academy of Sciences

articleTitle: Technological Efficiency of Computer Science Education Results in a Secondary School as a Factor of the Quality of Education in the Distance Learning System
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Considered an algorithmic approach to achieving students' educational results in the school course of computer science in the distance learning system, which is relevant in modern conditions. The main characteristics of the technological effectiveness of learning outcomes are given in the example of a computer science course.

articleTitle: Search for a New Paradigm of Education and Artificial Intelligence. Place and Role of Artificial Intelligence in the New Education System
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Humanity is on the cusp of the fourth industrial revolution. Cardinal changes are expected in all spheres of human activity, including the education system. A global reform of education is expected, which will lead to a change in its very paradigma, the creation of a new teaching methodology, a change in the forms and methods of teaching, and the creation of new teaching methods. But in this direction there are many difficulties and unsolved scientific problems. For example, there is no clear idea of what the “paradigm of education” is, how it is related to the teaching methodology, and the ways of transforming the education system are not defined. The paper considers new models of the use of information technologies in teaching, defines the place and role of artificial intelligence in the new education system.

articleTitle: School Research Activity as a Form of Early Mathematical Training
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The aim of this study is to present the experience of engaging schoolchildren in research activities through project activities implementing similar principles to the concept of mathematization. Formation of interdisciplinary competencies through project activities in the field of applied mathematics allows students to realize the possibility of applying mathematical knowledge to problems formulated in a real context, which is an important motivator in the learning process. The paper deals with the peculiarities of organizing project activities for schoolchildren and gives examples of successfully implemented cases, which were presented at the Russian project program “Step into the Future”.

articleTitle: Nature Management Models as a Tool for Forming Optimisation Thinking of Students
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: In the frames of the process of informatisation of education, the issue of the formation of optimization thinking among high school students has been considered. The formation of this kind of competences cannot be ensured by purely theoretical training; therefore, it is proposed to use models of optimal environmental management as vivid examples of solving optimization problems. The models illustrate such basic optimization concepts as the objective functional, different kinds of constraints, and the formulation of nonlinear and dynamic programming problems. Using the examples of managing the process of forest restoration, the importance of the correct selection of parameters of the model and methods for solving the optimization problem is shown. Concrete examples of using the proposed technique are given.

articleTitle: On Some Possibilities of Using Digital Technology in Foreign Language Teaching at Higher Education Institutions
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The author considers the possibilities of digital technologies in teaching foreign languages at universities. The article describes the advantages of their use in the teaching process which provide: flexibility in managing students' learning and independent activity; activation of students' activity and motivation in learning a foreign language; control of students' learning and independent activity; the choice of didactic materials in a foreign language; development of foreign language communicative competence of speech, language, intercultural, educational and cognitive components; upbringing personality capable of self-development and etc. Examples of solving linguodidactic tasks when using digital technology are given.

articleTitle: Fault Analysis Skills in Research and Development of Roof Constructions with Polymer Membrane Shell
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Polymer membrane roofs are efficient building constructions which fully comply with the concept of sustainable development. They are architecturally impressive and recyclable. Design omissions and deterioration of the structural elements with time, however, are significant issues. They require training competent specialists to be fixed and mitigated. The following fault analysis skills are considered in the present paper: identifying features which indicate the structural failure, tracking failure propagation throughout the membrane, detecting anomalies in the behavior of the building constructions using artificial neural networks. Fault analysis skills imply teamwork, rather than standalone personal activity. They contribute to firm development of soft skills of the researchers and stimulate using high-level open source software libraries for artificial intelligence applications. Development of fault analysis skills helps the researcher and the project manager to gain an insight into the structural behavior of deteriorated building constructions. It facilitates engineering of preventive measures for avoiding serious damages or even structural collapse.

articleTitle: Teaching Schoolchildren to Program in Python Environment in Online Communities
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article deals with the issues of teaching the schoolchildren of the online communities of computer programming in Python environment with the use of the systems of Learning Management Systems and the services of the Internet: Google Docs and Google Colabratory.

Author Keywords: the State Unified Exam of Computer Science and Information and Communication Technologies
online community of students of schools

articleTitle: An Innovative Concept for the Construction of Short Basic Math Courses
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The paper discusses an innovative concept of building a course in teaching mathematical disciplines for students of non-mathematical specialties. A mechanism has been developed that makes it possible to significantly modernize the educational methodology of presenting the course of mathematical analysis. A system of filling the didactic and methodological support of the course is proposed, including modern technologies of distance, electronic and online learning. The use of computer task generators and modern computer mathematical packages in the practice of teaching mathematics at universities is considered. The inclusion of informational content raises the level of the traditional course presentation, taking it to a higher level of interaction between the lecturer and the audience. The practical use of the proposed concept contributes to the creative development and professional growth of teachers.

Author Keywords: theory of the limit of a function

articleTitle: Use of Hybrid Learning in School Education in France
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The paper presents a review of the hybrid (blended) learning concept in the system of national education in France, notes its relationship with distance and classical (full-time) education, reviews the main methods and tools of its implementation, shows the positive sides and presents recommendations for this new concept of learning.

articleTitle: Researching the Usage of Blockchain in Higher Education
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Trends in the development of the modern digital economy have determined the practical digital transformation of all aspects of human activity, including both production and social spheres. Currently, technologies are dynamically developing and under their influence; the volume of received, transmitted and stored information is constantly increasing. Accordingly, demand for Big Data technology is growing, since it allows you to work with large amounts of data, which determines the growing popularity of blockchain technology. This article presents a model of the workings of blockchain technology in an educational organization and the procedures for its use. It also highlights several directions for the development of educational institutions and processes that are based on the use of blockchain technology. These include confirmation of the authenticity of documentation, accreditation of an educational organization, confirmation of intellectual property and identification of students. In addition, the article discusses the problem of the attitude of the academic community towards blockchain technologies, which can significantly reduce the intensity of implementation. This paper presents a study of why professionals in the educational field are afraid of a significant digitalization in education. Thus, a balanced approach is the optimal strategy for introducing blockchain technologies into educational processes.

articleTitle: On the Issue of the Problems of Legal Obligation in the Welfare State in the Context of a Pandemic
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The purpose of this article is to consider the theory of legal obligation through the prism of modern problems of building a social legal state. The article uses the following research methods: theoretical analysis, generalization, abstraction, formal legal and comparative legal. The author of the article notes the connection between legal obligation and social obligation and with public law, with social responsibility and state coercion, with the absolute imperative of power. The results of the study are the determination by its author of the determinants of the destruction of the nature of legal obligation; it is shown that the rule of law, which is not social, is not able to provide its citizens with protection and guarantees of their rights and freedoms. The main conclusions of the study are that the welfare state is a jurisdictionally separate legal space of rights and obligations, where public obligations must be balanced by the subjective rights of citizens; and it is also substantiated that the legal obligation plays the role, on the one hand, of a kind of «restrictive barrier» that delimits civil relations from other relations that operate with imperative methods and apply state coercion under the guise of a legal obligation, but on the other hand, it sets the permissible boundaries for the exercise of independent expression of will citizens.

articleTitle: Multi-criteria Model of Evaluating the Effectiveness of IT-department Employees
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article is devoted to the problem of increasing the efficiency of the IT-department. The authors propose using a mathematical model for obtaining a consolidated assessment of employees. Evaluation is formed according to criteria that take into account the IT department specifics. The developed specialized criteria for evaluation are presented in detail. Individual grading scales are proposed for each selected criterion. The methodology which is used to assess the IT department employee effectiveness can also be used as a tool for training future specialists. Since the criteria were formed on the example of a real operating organization with its actual structure of work and the requirements of the IT department, even at the stage of obtaining higher professional education, it is possible to conduct preliminary training of students based on given and alternative examples focused on the real needs of organizations. Knowledge of the criteria, rating scales, and their importance for the enterprise will help future specialists integrate quickly into organisations' work processes.

articleTitle: Informatization as a Condition for the Development of Academic Disciplines by Students of a Higher Educational Institution
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article enlightens the role of information technology in the educational process of a modern higher educational institution. The authors of the work talk about the need to apply new methods and models of communication in their work. The authors investigate the forms of communication of participants in the educational process used in distance learning, suggesting that information resource portals are a promising area of educational communications. The purpose of the study is to analyze effective forms of e-learning. The authors note the prospects for the development of e-learning. The conclusions made by the authors of the article make it possible to assert the need to apply new educational models and technologies in the activities of teachers of higher educational institutions.

articleTitle: Implementation of Interdisciplinary Relations on the Example of Professional Training in “Business Informatics” in the Context of a Pandemic
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The article considers the development of IT students' professional competencies and skills of modeling and reengineering of business processes on the example of training bachelors in the specialty 38.03.05 “Business Informatics” at NUST MISIS. The key problems of IT specialists training (especially, the issues of the development of professional competencies) and methods of their solution are considered. A sequence of modeling steps has been proposed, enabling one to perform a system and business analysis of an enterprise as an economic and management entity for the purpose of its business processes reengineering, up to the implementation of a prototype of the process under study with respect to its robotization as part of the graduation thesis. The article summarizes the experience of using the competence-activity approach, interdisciplinary communications and blended learning using an electronic educational environment and adaptive educational trajectories, including during the pandemic.

articleTitle: Designing Eco-cultural Development of Students' Personality in the Digital Educational Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: The broad concept of the environment can be revealed through the necessary degree of concretization of human interaction with it, including with the digital educational environment. There is a problem of finding optimal approaches for pedagogical adaptation of the potential of the digital educational environment to the tasks of ecological development of the personality. The research is based on theoretical analysis and comparison of classical and modern approaches to the problem under study. Netnographic study was a large-scale empirical study for the level of ecological culture of students (9395 people). The distribution of students' responses was performed using Pearson's criterion. The phenomenological aspect of human ecological development has been sufficiently studied in terms of theory, methodology, and application. An analysis of presented approaches has contributed to the definition of the term "ecologically oriented personality". The issue of digital technology application for the development and implementation of the process under consideration has been insufficiently studied. As a result of empirical research, we have obtained a stable trend showing positive results related to the motivation for environmental-oriented activities among students, with the presence of axiological determinants for environmental-oriented activities, including those related to the small Homeland. Taking into account the significant involvement of the student community in the digital educational space, the correlation between the dominants in environmental thinking caused by the digital socio-cultural reality is revealed, which confirms the theoretically justified determinants of individual eco-cultural development.

articleTitle: Application of Data Mining Methods to Development of Qualification Framework Standards
publicationTitle: 2021 1st International Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning in Higher Education (TELE)
abstract: Specific features of creating a Web environment for implementing feedback with stakeholders of the education system being discussed. Specific focus is aimed on the representatives of real economy. Authors propose mechanism of constructing individual environment for each individual user, associating their roles (during the registration process), e.g. with specific economic sectors and professions as the user registers as a professional in the labor market. Depending on the educational/professional interests of the users, individual questionnaires may be designed for an intelligent data mining. The necessity to rank the votes by significance, degree of confidence in the qualifications of respondents is highlighted. Algorithms for selecting the most important and relevant lists of competencies and disciplines in various professional training profiles are considered. Methods for designing networks that can be used to build classification rules, revealing hidden dependencies among professions and labor standards are discussed.
